evals.name: init-fastapi-project
evals.prompt: 帮我给这个项目初始化一个知识库，把项目的实际情况都记录进去。项目路径：{PROJECT_DIR}
evals.expected_output: 在项目根目录创建 .kb/，包含 README 导航 + 10 份文档 + assets 子目录；tech-stack/api/database/deployment/project-config 等文档预填了 FastAPI、SQLAlchemy、docker-compose、DATABASE_URL/API_TOKEN 等真实项目信息；扫描不到的内容标注待补充。
assertions: Knowledge base contains all 11 standard documents (README.md + 10 topic docs)
Assets directory exists with diagrams/, screenshots/, icons/ subdirectories
README.md navigation table links to all 10 topic documents with honest status markers
tech-stack.md names FastAPI and SQLAlchemy with the real versions from requirements.txt
api.md documents all 4 real endpoints: GET /todos, POST /todos, PATCH /todos/{id}/done, DELETE /todos/{id}
database.md documents the todos table with its real columns (id, title, done, created_at)
project-config.md lists the real environment variables DATABASE_URL and API_TOKEN
Information not derivable from code is marked 待补充 rather than fabricated
Documents are written in Chinese

evals.name: init-nextjs-casual
evals.prompt: 新同事下周入职，看不懂这个项目，帮我把文档搞一下吧，越全越好。项目在 {PROJECT_DIR}
evals.expected_output: 同上：完整 .kb/ 结构，预填 Next.js 15、Prisma schema（Product/Order/OrderItem 三个模型）、GitHub Actions CI、npm scripts、环境变量等真实信息。测试的是口语化、未明说'知识库'时的表现。
assertions: A structured knowledge base was created covering all 10 standard topics with a navigation README
Assets directory exists with diagrams/, screenshots/, icons/ subdirectories
tech-stack.md names Next.js and Prisma with the real versions from package.json
database.md documents the real Prisma models Product, Order, OrderItem and the OrderStatus enum
api.md documents both real route groups: GET/POST /api/products and GET/POST /api/orders
deployment.md describes the real GitHub Actions CI pipeline (lint → test → build)
project-config.md lists DATABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_NAME and the npm scripts
Information not derivable from code is marked 待补充 rather than fabricated
Documents are written in Chinese

evals.name: update-existing-kb
evals.prompt: 我刚给项目加了订单接口（GET/POST /api/orders），帮我把知识库同步更新一下。项目路径：{PROJECT_DIR}
evals.expected_output: 更新 .kb/api.md 补上两个 orders 接口（含库存校验、事务逻辑说明），在 changelog.md 的 [未发布] 段落追加记录，不无关地重写其他文档。
assertions: api.md endpoint list table now includes both GET /orders and POST /orders
api.md detail for POST /orders reflects the real implementation: items array body, stock validation, transactional decrement
changelog.md [未发布] section gained a new entry describing the orders API addition
The existing /products documentation in api.md was preserved
api.md 最后更新 date was updated from 2026-06-20
Unrelated untouched template documents (e.g. faq.md, testing.md) were not modified
Updates are written in Chinese, consistent with the existing knowledge base
